The look in words: detailed retro pixel art for a large boss sprite of a modern retro first-person horde shooter set on a cold moonlit night; every material shaded with 3 to 4 flat tones, lit softly from the upper front; many small pixel clusters for the cracks and rocky plates of the hide and for the bark; thin dark interior lines; a muted, slightly desaturated night palette in which only the ember eyes are bright. Everything below is an original design.

STYLE: a 2D PIXEL-ART SPRITE SHEET for a video game. True low-resolution pixel art: each figure is about 150 art pixels tall and every art pixel is a crisp square block of the same size, hard edges, NO anti-aliasing, NO gradients, NO soft airbrush shading, NO blur, NO noise texture; a limited muted palette (about 12 to 16 flat colours for the character); a clean 1 to 2 art-pixel near-black outline (#1a1418) around every figure. All figures face the viewer (front view, toward the camera, like enemies charging at the player), drawn at the same scale in every frame, feet on a common baseline within each row.
BACKGROUND: one flat, perfectly uniform, solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere behind and between the figures. No ground, no floor line, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no numbers, no frame borders, no grid lines.

THE CHARACTER, THE ASH TROLL (a boss, very large): a huge hulking troll, heavy and stooped, long thick arms that reach its knees, a small head sunk between massive shoulders, a heavy brow and a jutting jaw with two blunt tusks. Its hide is grey-black ASH: cracked like burnt charcoal, with a network of thin darker seams and pale ash-grey highlights on the shoulders and knuckles, rough and stony. Its two small eyes glow ember orange (the ONLY warm colour on it). A ragged dark-brown loincloth. In its right hand it drags a FALLEN PINE TREE TRUNK as a club (rough grey-brown bark, broken branch stubs, torn roots at the end it grips). Colours: charcoal, ash grey, slate, dark brown; the eyes ember orange.

LAYOUT: exactly 7 figures of the SAME troll in 2 horizontal rows, read left to right:
Row 1 (top, 4 figures) WALK CYCLE, heavy lumbering steps toward the viewer: (1) left foot forward; (2) feet passing, body higher; (3) right foot forward; (4) feet passing, body higher. The trunk in its right hand.
Row 2 (bottom, 3 figures) DEATH: (5) staggering backward, head thrown back, the trunk falling from its hand; (6) fallen to its knees, slumped forward, arms hanging; (7) collapsed face-down on the ground as a low heap of cracked ash, crumbling.
Every figure stands alone with wide magenta gaps; nothing touches or overlaps.
